svg.title: Chengyu of the day: 未雨绸缪 (traditional 未雨綢繆), wèi yǔ chóu móu, “Bind the windows before it rains”. Test the backup restore while nothing is on fire. The characters write themselves in stroke by stroke, in Simplified and then in Traditional.

g.text: Test the backup restore while nothing is on fire.
in real stroke order · a new one every day
